item.content:encoded:
No vote. I do like the concept of a canon based on the complete inexistence of the secrecy veil because this initial premise alone implies that this alternate reality would be entirely different from the "regular" Foundation's universe in regards to a number of aspects.

With that being said, this tale ultimately expose the reader too little to the aforementioned alternative reality and after everything has been said and done, we know that the GOC and The Foundation are public organizations now, some SCPs are free to roam around and that's pretty much it. I would gladly have upvoted if more attention was dedicated to the channels that were skipped rather than to Iris’s interview, which felt like the least relevant broadcast to me and yet received the most exposure.
